org.title: Organize library
org.subtitle: Move your media into a folder you choose, named by capture date. Dry-run first, undo any batch.
org.rootsHint: One destination folder per drive - any name, any location. Files stay on their own drive (instant rename, no copying).
org.noRoots: Pick a library folder to get started.
org.templateHint: Folder layout and file names are templates - change them to anything you like.
org.includeUncertain: Also organize files with uncertain dates (file-time only)
org.confirm: Move {{n}} files into your library folders? Every move is journaled and can be undone.
org.missingRoots: Drives without a library folder yet: {{drives}}
org.undoConfirm: Move {{n}} files back to where they were? Files whose target changed since are skipped and reported.

dedup.empty: No duplicates found. Hit "Scan for duplicates" after indexing.
dedup.pickGroup: Pick a group on the left. Checked cards get deleted, the rest stay.
dedup.confirm: Move {{n}} files ({{size}}) to the Recycle Bin? Live Photo videos go along with their photos. At least one verified copy of each photo always stays.
dedup.deleteResult: Moved {{n}} files to Recycle Bin ({{size}} freed)

reason.NO_RECYCLE_BIN: {{n}} on a drive without a Recycle Bin (external/FAT32) - delete those manually
reason.TRASH_FAILED: {{n}} failed to move to the Recycle Bin
reason.KEEP_NONE: {{n}} blocked: a whole group can never be deleted
reason.HASH_MISMATCH: {{n}} whose content doesn't match the kept copy
reason.CHANGED_ON_DISK: {{n}} changed on disk since hashing - rescan and retry
reason.SURVIVOR_CHANGED: {{n}} skipped because the kept copy changed on disk
reason.NOT_IN_GROUP: {{n}} not part of any duplicate group

dedup.keepGuard: At least one copy must stay in every group
dedup.keys: Space / click: mark for deletion · 1-9: keep that copy · Arrows: move · Enter: next group · Wheel: synced zoom

lightbox.noPreview: No preview for this format yet
lightbox.codecUnsupported: This codec can't be played in-app
lightbox.cloudOnly: This file lives in the cloud only - download it first (TidyMedia never triggers downloads)

roots.title: Watched folders
roots.empty: Nothing yet. Click "+ Add" and pick a whole drive (e.g. D:\) or a folder.
roots.removeConfirm: Remove "{{path}}" from the index? (files on disk are not touched)
roots.pickTitle: Pick a folder / drive to index

wizard.title: Welcome to TidyMedia
wizard.subtitle: Two quick choices - you can change them later via ⚙.
wizard.excludedEmpty: None - every folder in watched roots is scanned.
wizard.excludePick: Pick a folder to exclude from scanning
wizard.rescanHint: Excluded folders changed - hit ⟳ on your watched folders to apply.

errors.ERR_TPL_ABSOLUTE: Folder template must be relative (no drive or leading \)
errors.ERR_TPL_PARENT_REF: ".." is not allowed in the folder template
errors.ERR_TPL_SEP_IN_FILE: File name template can't contain \ or /
errors.ERR_ORG_BUSY: An organize or undo run is already in progress - wait for it to finish
errors.ERR_UNC_UNSUPPORTED: Network paths (\\server\…) are not supported yet: {{detail}}
errors.ERR_ROOT_DRIVE_RELATIVE: Pick a full path like D:\ - got {{detail}}
errors.ERR_ROOT_NO_DRIVE: Only local drives with a letter are supported: {{detail}}
errors.ERR_ROOT_UNREADABLE: Can't read this folder/drive - is it connected? {{detail}}
errors.ERR_SCAN_ACTIVE: This folder is already being scanned
errors.ERR_SCAN_STOP_TIMEOUT: Scan didn't stop in time - try again
errors.ERR_SCAN_WRITE_FAILED: Scan failed writing to the index: {{detail}}
errors.ERR_DB_WRITER_DOWN: Index database stopped responding - restart the app
errors.ERR_DB_NO_WAL: Index database location doesn't support fast mode: {{detail}}
errors.ERR_FILE_GONE: File no longer exists on disk: {{detail}}
errors.ERR_FILE_CLOUD: File is a cloud placeholder - download it first: {{detail}}
